name: Flat Couchout
description: Thrust the long ash straight forward from the lead foot, aiming the point at the opponent's chest.

name: Bracebump
description: Tuck the butt under the arm and lunge so the full weight of the body follows the point in.

name: Holding Pikebands
description: Raise the shaft across the body at port and knock an incoming cut aside along the wood.

name: Pikeamble
description: Slide the rear foot back half a pace while the point stays levelled at the foe.

name: Bracewedge
description: Rap the opponent's weapon sideways with the pike shaft to open a clear line for the point.

name: Raised Pikecollar
description: Hold the pike levelled at chest height so a rushing foe must stop beyond the length of the point.

name: Tending Pikehead
description: Carry the shaft on one shoulder at its balance point to feel its weight before lowering it level.

name: Wide Press
description: Slide the shaft through both palms in one smooth push so the point reaches the target at full length.

name: Kept Longpole
description: Raise the rear hand while dropping the point so the angled shaft turns a thrust aside.

name: Pikepace
description: Pivot on the lead foot while the long shaft swings round level, keeping the point clear of neighbours.

name: Steelcap Lid
description: Dip the point below the opponent's eyeline then lift it, drawing his guard high before the real thrust.

name: Pikestay
description: Space the hands a forearm apart and lock the elbows to hold the pike levelled against a shove.

name: Levelhold Dash
description: Pull the lead hand back and drive the rear hand forward as a fulcrum so the point jabs out fast.

name: Tight Ashstaff
description: Draw the shaft back hand over hand after a thrust, returning the point to guard before the counter lands.

name: Downward Pikeshaft
description: Slide both hands toward the butt during the thrust, gaining a forearm of reach and piercing deeper.

name: Descending Bristle
description: Choke both hands up near the head and stab short, where the full length of shaft would hinder you.

name: Pikecowl
description: Cross the hands high on the shaft to catch a downward cut on the ash above the head.

name: Brace Pause
description: Roll the shaft between the palms to twist the point around the opponent's weapon and drag it off line.

name: Holding Pikeshoe
description: Plant the butt in the ground behind the rear foot and angle the shaft up to receive a rushing foe.

name: Steelcap Husk
description: Pin the iron-shod butt under the heel and level the point so a charging foe meets the ash.

name: Bracetrot
description: Wedge the rear foot against the planted butt, then step the lead foot forward without shifting the shaft.

name: Flat Present
description: Thrust up and forward from the planted butt, letting the ground carry the recoil back through the shaft.

name: Couchout Dash
description: Lean the whole body into the braced shaft to shove a foe backward off his footing.

name: Quiet Pikehead
description: Lift the butt and re-plant it a pace aside after the foe sidesteps, restoring the brace.

name: Fixing Mastlength
description: Shake the planted shaft sharply so a hand or hook grabbing it loses its hold.

name: Upward Mastlength
description: Sweep the low point sideways across the shins of an advancing foe, aiming to trip him.

name: Stepping Levelhold
description: Carry the pike sloped over one shoulder and step evenly in time with the file.

name: Ready Footspike
description: Halt on the beat and drop the butt to the ground, bringing the point level in one motion.

name: Low Footspike
description: Drop the sloped pike to level mid-stride and thrust at the end of the step.

name: Ashstaff Skitter
description: Tilt the shaft upward and lean aside to pass a neighbour's pike without catching the wood.

name: Easing Longpole
description: Wheel a quarter turn on the spot with the pike held upright to face a new front.

name: Folded Pikecollar
description: Step back into the rank behind and sweep the shaft across to cover the gap just left.

name: Pikeshoe Count
description: Let circulating qi warm both palms and run a thin line along the shaft, firming the grip.

name: Level Bristle
description: Jab the pike forward with a thread of qi at the head, so the point lands sharper and truer.

name: Solid Footspike
description: Hold the breath and drop the butt to the ground, steadying the braced shaft with a little qi.

name: Kept Ashstaff
description: Slide the warmed shaft against an incoming weapon and let it glide off the smooth ash.

name: Masttrot
description: Send a pulse of qi to the legs and advance two quick paces with the pike still level.

name: Breathed Present
description: Draw the pike back on the inhale and thrust on the exhale, matching breath to the stroke.

name: Raised Pikeshaft
description: Breathe slowly while holding the pike level, so steady qi keeps the point from drifting.

name: Blunt Couchout
description: Breathe out as the thrust lands so the qi follows the point and sinks the head deeper.

name: Swaying Pikebands
description: Count each breath to a footfall and advance in an even rhythm that keeps the pike steady.

name: Bracelid
description: Hold the breath and wrench the shaft sharply to throw an opposing weapon off its line.

name: Lowered Longpole
description: Pull the pike back as the breath settles, turning aside a counter with the returning shaft.

name: Steelcap Note
description: Lock the breath at contact so the wrists stay firm and the point stays on its line.

name: Mastnote
description: Run qi from the rear hand to the point and back, warming the whole ash in one loop.

name: Masthusk
description: Draw the pike back with the returning qi loop so the shaft sweeps a thrust aside.

name: Mastdrop
description: Thrust with qi flowing the whole shaft length, driving the point through light armour.

name: Raised Pikebands
description: Plant the butt and hold a looping qi flow in the shaft to absorb a rushing weight.

name: Pikecollar Note
description: Send qi to the point and read the weight and push of any weapon touching it.

name: Quiet Brace
description: Let the qi circuit carry the lead foot forward a pace while the pike stays levelled.

name: Mastcowl
description: Set the iron ferrule against the rear foot and lock both with qi so a charge cannot push them.

name: Pikedodge
description: Pivot on the rear foot with the butt dragging, re-setting the brace toward a new threat.

name: Pikecount
description: Send qi down the shaft into the ferrule so it bites the ground and resists a shove.

name: Descending Present
description: Strike upward from the anchored brace, the rising point catching a foe under the guard.

name: Shaftdrop
description: Drive the iron butt backward into a foe who has slipped behind the line.

name: Shafthop
description: Send qi into the lead foot and surge forward a full pace, dragging the shaft level behind.

name: Pikewedge
description: Kick the butt up off the ground so the shaft springs into guard and turns a cut aside.

name: Forward Press
description: Reverse the grip and stab with the iron-shod butt, qi hardening the end against mail.

name: Narrow Bristle
description: Extend to the point's full reach with a thread of qi, piercing a foe still outside his own reach.

name: Holding Pikeshaft
description: Brace the rear foot hard and let qi lock the shaft to take a charge on the point.

name: Quiet Pikeshoe
description: Slide backward in small steps so the point always stays at its full reach from the foe.

name: Bracestay
description: Hold the point steady at the opponent's throat line so he dare not step inside.

name: Folded Mastlength
description: Snap the extended pike back to guard with a pulse of qi, turning aside an answering blow.
